attributes.board_name: New Hampshire Physical Therapy Governing Board (Office of Professional Licensure and Certification)

rules.accepted_credit_types: No pre-approval; no delivery-method restriction. Academic PT instruction (5 h per credit hour); courses, seminars, conferences (1 clock hour = 1 CE); facility in-services (max 8); mentored independent study (2 h = 1 CE, max 8); clinical student supervision >48 h (2 CE per student, max 8); supervision of conditional licensees (2 CE each, max 8); publications (book 12, peer-reviewed chapter/article 6, other 4; max 2 writings); presentations and teaching (2 CE per hour, max 8 each); research (4 h = 1 CE, max 8); boards/committees (2 CE each, max 4); infection control, BLS, onboarding, HIPAA and annual training (max 2); journal study (4 CE, max 4); NH jurisprudence module (2 CE); specialty certification exam (24 CE); residency/fellowship (1 h = 1 CE, max 24); residency/fellowship clinical mentoring (4 CE per resident, max 12).
rules.new_licensee_rule: No different requirement for the first renewal (Board CE page).
rules.audit_note: CE activities are listed on the Addendum to the Universal Renewal Application; 10% of renewals randomly audited each renewal year (proof due within 30 days; late proof fined $50/$100).

topics.who: New Hampshire jurisprudence assessment module (by FSBPT; RSA 328-A, Phy 100-500 and the APTA Code of Ethics / PTA Standards of Ethical Conduct), taken April-June of years ending in 0 and 5, pass mark 80%; counts as 2 CE

rules.legal_basis: N.H. Code Admin. R. Phy 402.01-402.08, Phy 406
rules.notes: 24 contact hours per 2-year license cycle: at least 12 relating directly and primarily to the clinical application of physical therapy, the rest to general physical therapy practice. Licensees have free CE Broker tracking accounts (optional). No mandatory topic courses.
